packageRules.description: Root only: @typescript-eslint/parser peers typescript ">=4.8.4 <6.1.0", so TypeScript 7 breaks npm ci with ERESOLVE. functions/ has no eslint and is already on 7. Lift this once the parser widens its peer range.

uuid is not a dependency of this app - it appears nowhere in src/, functions/src/ or scripts/. Both entries are overrides that only force someone else's transitive uuid past advisory GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq, whose range is "<11.1.1", so ^11.1.1 already clears it and a major bump buys no security. Holding at 11.x also keeps the functions override off an ESM-only uuid inside gaxios/firebase-admin in production. Drop this rule if the app ever imports uuid directly.
